title: Launch Monitor Ball Speed Weekly Trend
dataSources: Golf rounds (`golf:round`), Garmin golf telemetry (`garmin:golf`), UDisc rounds (`udisc:round`), launch-monitor shots (`launchmonitor:shot`), handicap-index updates (`handicap:index`).
app: Arccos and Garmin S62 round telemetry, UDisc round exports, launch-monitor CSVs, and handicap-index updates streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted imports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=launchmonitor:shot
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(ball_speed_mph) as total_value avg(ball_speed_mph) as avg_value count as sessions by _time
| sort - _time
description: Trends ball speed in miles per hour week by week so you can see whether launch monitor ball speed is building, fading, or plateauing.
value: A weekly view turns isolated workouts or events into a training signal, making it easier to spot whether launch monitor ball speed is moving in the right direction.
implementation: Forward launch monitor ball speed into `index=personal`, keep `ball_speed_mph` populated, and review the weekly trend before planning the next block.
visualization: Line chart of weekly total and average ball speed in miles per hour.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how launch monitor ball speed changes from week to week so you can tell whether training or racing is moving the right way.
